messages:
alicia-sales: Hey team — prepping the Acme Health POC. Need to align on success criteria (latency / cost / quality), prompt/eval plan, timeline, and security asks. Can we do an async sync here? cc @sam-se @devon-ml @mike-sec

sam-se: Quick baseline: customer expects ~100 qps peak, mostly short prompts (<=256 tokens). Target p50 < 120ms, p95 < 450ms. Cost target: < $0.02 per completed request on average. Feasible?

devon-ml: Agree on latency targets. For quality let's use: >=92% exact match on a 200-example eval set + <2% high-hallucination failures. I'll author evals if sales shares sample prompts.

alicia-sales: Sharing example prompts from the customer: 1) summarize clinical note -> ~150-token output; 2) extract entities into JSON (patient, med, dose); 3) short QA. Multimodal is future. I'll upload a seed set by EOD.

jess-ops: :thumbsup: Ops note — plan is to use a dedicated GPU pool for the POC. Suggest autoscale min: 2 GPUs, burst: 6. Region: us-west-2 unless customer needs eu. Do they require KMS in their account?

mike-sec: They require SOC2 + HIPAA posture, KMS key in customer AWS account, and audit log retention 12 months. We'll need an SOW addendum and to complete their security questionnaire. Please forward it.

alicia-sales: Forwarded their sec questionnaire link: https://acme.example/sec-qa — they want answers by next Wed. Also pricing Q: they asked if we can offer a committed capacity discount for a 3-month POC. Need cap & burn estimate for commercial.

sam-se: Rough burn calc: 100 qps sustained => ~8.64M requests/day. If avg 40 tokens per request that's ~345M tokens/day. Over 14 days that's ~4.8B tokens. At hosted rates rough ballpark ~ $18k for the 2-week window; dedicated reserved for POC could drop to ~ $11–13k. I'll publish a spreadsheet with assumptions. Need to confirm model family/size.

devon-ml: They want open-7b quantized. Benchmarks we have: p50 ~90ms, p95 ~320ms on A100 for 256-context. Entity extraction tends to be stable; but structured JSON output needs strict evals + temperature control. I'll run the 200-sample eval on a min pool.

jess-ops: Suggested runbook snippet for canary/smoke checks (paste below):
```yaml
canary:
  request_count: 200
  error_rate_threshold: 0.01
  p95_latency_ms_threshold: 800
rollback: immediate
alerts:
  - on: p95_latency > 800ms
    notify: #eng-oncall, #sales
```

sam-se: Timeline check — can we aim to kick off POC next Monday (1933500000) and run 2 weeks?

alicia-sales: Customer prefers next Tue. Can we compress to 1 week instead? They want fast results.

jess-ops: We can compress to 1 week only if MSA + infra access + KMS provisioning are completed by Thu. Otherwise stick to 2 weeks.

mike-sec: Action items for sec: need their DPA and a KMS admin contact. Also note they requested token logging off by default for PHI — we support per-customer token filtering. I'll prepare answers to their questionnaire.

devon-ml: Action list from ML side: I'll create the eval set + bench script and run smoke tests on open-7b. @alicia-sales please send 20 sample clinical notes and expected JSON outputs. @jess-ops prepare dedicated pool cost estimate. @mike-sec will fill sec QA. @sam-se produce burn estimate spreadsheet.

alicia-sales: Sending sample prompts to this thread now. Please react with :eyes: or :thumbsup: once you review.

sam-se: :eyes: will review assumptions and post spreadsheet by EOD.

devon-ml: :thumbsup: starting eval runs tonight.

jess-ops: Added the POC ticket and runbook to the board: https://redwood.example/boards/poc-acme — assigned to ops oncall.

mike-sec: I'll DM Legal for the DPA template and open a HIPAA escalation in #security-hipaa.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled infra template deployment for poc-acme at 1933338000

alicia-sales: Great — closing async sync. If any blocker surfaces we'll do a 30-min call; otherwise I'll circulate a condensed SOW + timeline by EOD Friday.
